reason: Describes concrete long-side breakout rules from multi-week/month consolidation ranges on US stocks that survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: US stocks coming out of long consolidation or beaten-down ranges

setup.rule: stock consolidating in range after being beaten down, sellers dried up
setup.quote: finding stocks that are coming out of a malaise or coming out of a depression or or just or just coming out of just sitting around and consolidating and once I see them reversing and breaking some previous you know not just a day but going back you know a month sometimes two months sometimes a year

entry.rule: breakout above consolidation range high or VWAP
entry.quote: once they break out of that channel or that that range that they're sitting in

entry.rule: use 9-month or yearly VWAP as guide for breakout confirmation
entry.quote: once these stocks reverse and they break the vwap the trades have been working about 90% of the time

stop.rule: exit if fails to hold breakout or re-enters range
stop.quote: if it pulls back and you know goes right back down to 385 no harm no foul

exits.rule: scale out at prior breakdown highs or next range targets; use VWAP for profit taking
exits.quote: I'm using the vwap as a guide to where I might be looking to take some profit and if it does break over these yearly vaps you're getting another 10 15 20% on some of these stocks

sizing.rule: start small, scale out most on initial move, hold remainder as swing
sizing.quote: stock spurts 40 cents guess what I'm doing I'm selling 800 shares of it taking the money off the table and I'm holding 200 shares as a swing trade

market_filter.rule: prefer bull market environment for long breakouts
market_filter.quote: once the shorts get nervous the stock goes and has a monster move and I just go from stock to stock

ambiguities.issue: no exact numerical thresholds for range length, breakout pct, or stops given
ambiguities.assumption: use standard daily-bar breakout params with consolidation_days=20-60, momentum_min_pct=5-10
